title: Custom Community Themes & Free Theme Studio
releaseNotes: Added one-tap Custom & Community Theme support via deep links and QR codes from the free theme.kurzyrio.dev studio.
Themes save permanently offline with custom colors, gradients, frosted glass, and wallpaper photos or animated GIFs.
Full theme synchronization across every app screen, all 7 Android home screen widgets, the floating Eagle overlay, and an optional Match App Theme ongoing notification style.
